profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc is a for-profit public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with SEC CIK number 0001280263 and ticker AMBA. The company describes itself as a provider of AI vision processors for edge applications. Its website states that its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting valuable data from high-resolution video streams.

The company's site lists advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the areas it addresses. Ambarella has 281 law exposure entries in California.
